title: Power Apps: refreshed row summary layout and Microsoft-provided summaries on view pages
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing requirements and three configuration paths are supported. Remove the unsupported attribution that Learn calls summaries read-only, acknowledge the differing guidance on related-record links, and remove the checklist instruction for a control absent from the table.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans access to Microsoft-provided Customer Service and Sales summaries from view-page grids without opening each record.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes no new action for the refreshed layout.

claims.claim: Row summaries are AI-generated overviews of records in model-driven apps.

claims.claim: Existing custom summaries appear in the Insights bar on main forms.

claims.claim: The inline Summary action on view pages opens a record summary in a modal popup.

In the navigation pane, select Copilot, and then select Settings.

claims.claim: No documented automation operation sets the Row summaries environment control.
claims.quote: Searched: row summaries AI insight cards environment setting API PowerShell organization EnableFormInsights; "EnableFormInsights" "api-version". Opened SDK PowerAppsEnableFormInsights and settings PATCH reference; no request-body mapping is documented there.

claims.claim: The legacy control is at Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > AI insight cards.

In the navigation pane, select Manage.
In the Manage pane, select Environments.
On the Environments page, select an environment.
In the command bar, select Settings.
Expand Product, and then select Features.

AI insight cards

claims.where: controls[1].note; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: AI insight cards and Row summaries control the same capability.
claims.quote: The AI insight cards setting on this page and Row summaries in Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Summary control the same capability.

claims.claim: The legacy AI insight cards location will be removed in a future release, and Copilot settings is preferred.
claims.quote: Use the Copilot settings experience as the preferred location. The AI insight cards setting remains available on this page for now but will be removed in a future release.

claims.claim: Updating the legacy feature settings requires System Administrator or equivalent permissions.
claims.quote: Ensure you have the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions to update the settings.

claims.claim: No documented automation operation sets the legacy AI insight cards control.
claims.quote: Searched: "powerApps_EnableFormInsights" "Set"; "EnvironmentManagementSetting" "Update" "Microsoft.PowerPlatform". Opened settings-features, SDK property and settings PATCH reference; the latter does not document the deciding request property.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The maker toggle is at Power Apps > Tables > table > Customizations > Row summary > Show row summary.
claims.quote:
In Power Apps, select Tables on the left navigation pane, and open the table with the configured row summary.
Under Customizations, select Row summary.
In the prompt configuration screen, use the Show row summary toggle

claims.claim: Turning off Show row summary hides the table's configured custom summary.
claims.quote: Turning off Show row summary hides the configured summary from all main forms and view pages for the table.

claims.claim: The maker toggle does not hide Microsoft-provided or other application-configured summaries, including the default Case, Lead and Opportunity summaries.
claims.quote: The Show row summary toggle affects only custom row summaries configured from this row summary experience. It doesn't hide summaries provided by Microsoft or summaries configured through another application or experience

claims.claim: No documented API operation sets the Show row summary toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: "Show row summary" API ai skill config enabled; "AI Skill Config" "IsEnabled" Web API; "AI Skill Config" "Web API". Read configure-form-row-summary and AI Skill Config search excerpts; no operation and property for this toggle were found.

claims.claim: License enforcement rolls out gradually following general availability.
claims.quote: This license enforcement gradually rolls out following the feature's general availability.

claims.claim: Usage might be subject to service limits or throttling.
claims.quote: Usage might be subject to service limits or throttling.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Row summaries rely on AI Builder to execute summary prompts.
claims.quote: Row summaries rely on AI Builder to execute summary prompts.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Running AI Builder prompts in Power Apps consumes AI Builder credits or Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: In Power Apps and Power Automate, AI Builder features consume either AI Builder credits (Licensing and AI Builder credits), or Copilot Credits (Licensing and Copilot Credits).

claims.claim: The licensing model is mixed: user licenses plus metered AI Builder execution.
claims.quote: AI Builder is licensed on a capacity basis. Building custom and testing models (including prompts) doesn't require AI Builder credits or Copilot Credits. Running them in agents, agent flows, apps, or flows consume these credits.

claims.claim: Variable cost is justified by consumption of AI Builder credits or Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: AI Builder features in apps and flows first try to consume AI Builder credits, then if absent or exhausted, they try to consume Copilot Credits.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: No credit rate specific to row summaries is published.
claims.quote: Searched: "row summaries" credits rate licensing layout. Opened administer-licensing and row summary user, maker and FAQ pages; rates are by prompt model and tokens, with no row-summary-specific rate or model mapping.

claims.claim: No separate license or charge for the visual refresh is published.
claims.quote: Searched: "row summaries" credits rate licensing layout; "row summaries" "refreshed" layout setting generation labels. Opened administer-licensing and row summary documentation; none specifies a separate entitlement or charge for the refresh.

claims.claim: A Power Platform administrator enables the environment setting.
claims.quote: A Power Platform administrator must enable Row summaries for the environment in the Power Platform admin center under Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Summary.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope: Roles; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Makers configure summaries per table by choosing columns in the Prompt box.
claims.quote: In the Prompt box, add the columns that you want included in the summary by selecting Add or by typing /.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope: Users; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Custom summaries require configured and enabled table prompts.
claims.quote: Makers still need to configure and turn on summary prompts on individual tables so that row summaries appear on the corresponding forms and views.

claims.claim: The AI insight cards environment setting is on by default.
claims.quote: The AI insight cards environment setting that enables row summaries is on by default.

claims.claim: Learn describes summaries as read-only text.
claims.quote: Searched: "row summaries" "read-only". Read record-summaries, configure-form-row-summary and faq-record-summaries; they describe generated text and interaction buttons, but do not state that summaries are read-only.
claims.fix: Remove 'read-only' from the sentence, leaving: 'Learn describes summaries as text that users can copy, rate with thumbs up or down and, on forms, refresh.'

claims.claim: Users can copy summary text.
claims.quote: Copy: Select to copy the summary content directly to your clipboard for easy sharing or documentation.

claims.claim: Users can rate summaries using thumbs up or down.
claims.quote: Feedback: Use the thumbs up or thumbs down icons to rate the summary's usefulness.

claims.claim: Users can refresh summaries on forms.
claims.quote: Refresh (forms only): Select the Refresh button to regenerate the summary so it reflects the latest updates to the record.

claims.claim: The FAQ says row summaries cannot perform calculations.
claims.quote: Row summaries can't currently perform calculations.

claims.claim: The FAQ says row summaries cannot reference dates in relative terms.
claims.quote: Row summaries can't currently reference dates in relative terms, such as "yesterday" or "next week."

claims.claim: The FAQ says row summaries cannot include links to related records.
claims.quote: Row summaries can't include links to related records.
claims.fix: After the limits sentence add: 'The maker guide qualifies the related-record link limitation differently: "Hyperlinks to related records might not render as expected in the summary."' The guide is already cited: https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/data-platform/configure-form-row-summary#known-limitations.

claims.claim: The FAQ advises treating a summary as a starting point.
claims.quote: Treat the row summary as a helpful starting point for understanding a record. Review the record's fields and related data directly before making important decisions based on that data.
